data.title: Gas price increase from 1 November 2026
data.summary: Muster Gas GmbH announces a price increase for the "Muster Gas Komfort" gas tariff from 1 November 2026. The monthly advance payment rises from €96.00 to €109.00.
data.explanation: Your gas provider is raising the price per kWh from 10.94 to 12.36 ct. The base fee stays the same, and your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) goes up to €109.00. You may cancel the contract without a notice period, effective when the change takes effect. A text-form message such as an email is enough. You can decide whether to accept the new price or switch provider, and the app shows the window for this right. If you stay, no action is needed.
